items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; the file page associates the glyph model with oracle-bone record 合3298 but this redraw is not itself an artifact image
items.tradition: Modern vector redraw of an oracle-bone script form
items.caption: A modern vector reconstruction of 女 in Shang oracle-bone style; paleographic accounts describe the early graph as a kneeling female figure.
items.alt: Black line drawing of an oracle-bone-style 女 form on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Shows the reported early pictographic form and is directly identified by its Commons description page, which supplies source attribution and CC0/public-domain reuse information.
items.rights: CC0 1.0/public domain as stated on the Commons file description page.

items.period: Bronze-script style; exact artifact date unspecified on file page
items.tradition: Modern vector redraw of a bronze-script form
items.caption: A modern vector drawing of 女 in bronze-script style; CUHK describes later bronze forms as simplifying the seated posture.
items.alt: Black line drawing of a bronze-script-style 女 form on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Offers a second script-style candidate relevant to the reported graphic simplification, with an inspected description and reuse statement; no claim that it is a photographed inscription.
items.rights: Public domain as stated for the SVG representation on the Commons file description page.

limitations.text: Both candidates are modern vector redrawings. The Commons pages provide script-style identification and reuse terms, but the research did not inspect their pixels or verify either against a particular artifact image.
The exact Xiaoxuetang query record for 女 and an official direct CC0 notice page were not successfully opened in this session; no Xiaoxuetang-rendered image is proposed.
